title: Yo o Bidiwang mo Legaeng la Moporofeti
intro: Mo ntlong ya morongwa wa bofelo, go ne go nna mowa o kgang ya one ka namana e neng ya nna thuto ya bomodimo mo badumeding botlhe. Botshelo jwa motho yono bo ne bo amana thata le taelo e e fetolang e e neng ya bopa sesha dingwao tsa loago ka bosakhutleng, e leng se se neng se tshwaya phetogo e e tseneletseng mo tseleng e tumelo e neng e tla tlhalosa ka yone lelapa le go nna karolo ya setlhopha.
clues: Leina la me le kile la bo le golaganngwa le losika lo lo tlotlegang, mme moragonyana boammaaruri jo bo kwa godimo bo ne bo tla tlhalosa sentle dikgole tsa boammaaruri tsa tumelo.
Ke ne ke le moamogedi wa kamogelo e kgolo go tswa go Allah le morongwa wa Gagwe, kamogelo e e neng ya bolelwa phatlalatsa mo Bukeng.
Botshelo jwa me jwa lenyalo bo ne jwa nna teko e e botlhokwa thata e e neng e tla fetola ruri tsela e batho ba neng ba leba botsalano jo bo amogetsweng ka yone.
Ke ne ke le yo teko ya gagwe ka namana e neng ya dira gore go nne le taelo ya bomodimo e e neng e letla Moporofeti go nyala mosadi fa ke sena go tsamaya.
Ka kgang ya me, pharologano fa gare ga lelapa la madi le le tlhophilweng e ne ya tlhalosiwa sentle mo dikokomaneng tsotlhe.
Ke nna fela gareng ga balekane ba me yo leina la gagwe le tlhagelelang ka tlhamalalo mo tshenolong ya bofelo, e seng jaaka moporofeti, mme jaaka motlhanka yo o lekilweng le go tlotliwa.

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go fedisiwa ga go godisa ngwana jaaka tsela ya go tlhama kamano ya madi
Go tlhomiwa ga puso ya ntlha ya Boiselamo

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
